reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses oxide formation on Nb alloys and hot corrosion of HEA coatings, respectively; neither provides any data on Q235 steel, Mn/Si-enriched oxide scales, or the temperature-dependent protective mechanism proposed. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Pre-annealing Q235 steel in air at ~700 °C forms a Mn/Si-enriched native oxide scale
This oxide scale is continuous and adherent
The scale acts as a diffusion barrier against molten salt attack at 700–900 °C
The same scale offers little or no protection at room temperature
The protective effect is specific to high-temperature molten salt conditions
